headline: On October 25, 1989: Benfica and Belenenses kick off Supertaça
captionCards: First leg of 11th Supertaça at Estádio da Luz
Marked a key moment in Portuguese football rivalry
instagramCaption:
Benfica and Belenenses face off in a historic match.\nThe first leg of the 1989 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira was held at the Estádio da Luz in Lisbon, Portugal. Benfica, having won the 1988–89 Primeira Divisão, faced Belenenses, the 1988–89 Taça de Portugal champions. This edition marked the 11th year of the Supertaça, a significant event in Portuguese football history. The match remains a symbol of the fierce rivalry and high-stakes competition in Portuguese football. \nWhat do you think made this match so memorable? \\[Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳]
